2.163.4
GaugePanel.Bookmark
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The GaugePanel.Bookmark element specifies a bookmark that can be linked to via a bookmark
action for a GaugePanel. The GaugePanel.Bookmark element is optional. If this element is present,
its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a
String.
The following is the parent element of the GaugePanel.Bookmark element.
Parent elements
GaugePanel
The following is the XML Schema definition of the GaugePanel.Bookmark element.
 <xsd:element name="Bookmark" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0">
